Repository Copilot Instructions

- Be concise and prioritize small, reviewable edits.
- Use `apply_patch` to modify files; create new files only when necessary and keep them minimal.
- Always use the `manage_todo_list` tool for multi-step or multi-file tasks and mark progress.
- Before making large or cross-cutting changes, ask the repo owner for confirmation.
- Preserve existing coding and content style. Wrap commands or file names in backticks when documenting.
- Add links to changed files in PR descriptions and include a short rationale.
